summary: Action Audit Unified Panel Integration Testing Complete. All 8 test features verified: (1) Traceability buttons open drawer without route change, (2) Action Audit Aç button shows action audit list, (3) Audit Logs Aç button shows audit logs, (4) Filter bar works (user_id/action_type/last N hours/trace_id), (5) Required fields visible in rows (action_name, actor, timestamp, trace_id, status, message, state_snapshot), (6) Detail panel shows expanded JSON on row selection, (7) Hardening Analytics tab shows override/heartbeat/gate/ws critical actions, (8) Action Audit link removed from sidebar.
critical_code_review_comments: Route preservation verified: openAuditDrawer uses Sheet component instead of navigate(), URL stays at /admin/pipeline-operations
Drawer has 3 tabs: Action Audit, Audit Logs, Hardening Analytics - all functional
Filter bar has 4 inputs: user_id, action_type, since_hours (last N hours), trace_id - all working
Action Audit items show required fields: action_name, actor/timestamp, trace_id, status, message, state_snapshot summary
Detail panel shows full JSON on row click
Hardening Analytics filters for OVERRIDE/HEARTBEAT/GATE/WS_ actions correctly
Sidebar PanelLayout.jsx has no Action Audit navigation link - correctly removed
